The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session combinations.
While 5 tests passed, test_word_summary_content failed with 'AssertionError: Word summary must mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations'. Avoid omitting specific session identifiers in the Document paragraphs; ensure the top 4 sessions by total variance are explicitly mentioned in the text.
